title: Fixed Night Prayers
description: Night prayers — thanksgiving, protection, and repose · ~5 min

evening_protection.text:
Visit, we beseech you, O Lord, this dwelling,
and drive far from it all the snares of the enemy.
Let your holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace,
and may your blessing be always upon us.
Through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Amen.
evening_protection.latin:
Visita, quaesumus, Domine, habitationem istam,
et omnes insidias inimici ab ea longe repelle.
Angeli tui sancti habitent in ea, qui nos in pace custodiant,
et benedictio tua sit super nos semper.
Per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
Amen.

evening_thanksgiving.text:
O God, our life, our strength, our food,
our rest, our peace, our all:
I thank you for the gifts of this day.
Forgive me the sins I have committed,
and the virtue I have failed to practice.
Bless those I love,
have mercy on those who have wronged me,
and make me faithful to you unto death.
Grant me and all for whom I pray
a peaceful night and a holy death.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
evening_thanksgiving.latin:
Deus, vita nostra, fortitudo nostra, cibus noster,
requies nostra, pax nostra, omnia nostra:
tibi gratias ago pro donis huius diei.
Ignosce mihi peccata quae commisi,
et virtutem quam exercere neglegi.
Benedic quos diligo,
miserere eorum qui mihi nocuerunt,
et fac me tibi fidelem usque ad mortem.
Concede mihi et omnibus pro quibus oro
noctem placidam et mortem sanctam.
Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

bedtime_examination.text:
O my God, I adore you
and I love you with all my heart.
I thank you for having created me,
made me a Christian,
and preserved me this day.
Forgive me the evil I have done this day
and if I have done any good,
accept it.
Watch over me as I take my rest
and deliver me from all danger.
May your grace be always with me
and with all those dear to me.
Amen.

act_of_contrition.text:
O my God, I am heartily sorry for having offended Thee,
and I detest all my sins because of Thy just punishments,
but most of all because they offend Thee, my God,
who art all good and deserving of all my love.
I firmly resolve, with the help of Thy grace,
to sin no more and to avoid the near occasions of sin.
Amen.
act_of_contrition.latin:
Deus meus, ex toto corde poenitet me omnium meorum peccatorum,
eaque detestor, quia peccando,
non solum poenas a Te iuste statutas promeritus sum,
sed praesertim quia offendi Te, summum bonum,
ac dignum qui super omnia diligaris.
Ideo firmiter propono, adiuvante gratia Tua,
de cetero me non peccaturum peccandique occasiones proximas fugiturum.
Amen.
